purpose: Teach: 儀礼/貫く/浮き彫り/造船/応じる/騙し/辞退/モニタリング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Never skip external protocols. They're what we show the world.
lines.style: Crisp, commanding opening. Even measured pace. No room for negotiation in the tone. Authority sitting light on the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。理念を貫く姿勢、社内で徹底します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the whole team lives those principles—no exceptions.
lines.style: Respectful but not obsequious. Slight nod in the voice. Steady, deliberate pace. Speaking the commitment back to show he's taken it in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の課題、浮き彫りにせよ。
lines.en: And I want the real problems in this industry brought into the light.
lines.style: Measured, expectant. Slight weight on 'real.' Not a request—a clear expectation. Pause before the final phrase to let it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 造船関連の取引、再点検します。
lines.en: I'll audit the shipbuilding contracts again. Top to bottom.
lines.style: Focused, methodical. Slight emphasis on 'again'—showing he understands the scope. Clipped, efficient delivery. No hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 監査に応じる体制、整えろ。
lines.en: We need to be ready for any audit they throw at us.
lines.style: Controlled, firm. Each clause lands distinctly. Pace steady, not rushed. The tone of someone who doesn't accept failure as an option.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 騙し被害、再発防止策、共有しました。
lines.en: We've already shared the full deception prevention plan. Everyone knows what to do.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, reassuring through competence. Quick, clean delivery. Slight emphasis on 'already'—showing work is done. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員辞退者、モニタリングを継続。
lines.en: Keep watching the people who stepped down. They're not off the board yet.
lines.style: Final directive, quiet weight. Clipped, decisive. The last sentence lands like a door closing. Attention to detail even in dismissal.
